origin: converted from a local proprietary table (database/mydb.json) with tools/import_db.py; the source table is not redistributed and this derived file is kept out of the repository (.gitignore)
how_to_tune: entries are weighted by n (sessions); learn from your own captures with tools/build_db.py, or convert a foreign table with tools/import_db.py - see README.md

field_help.n: how many sessions of real traffic this profile stands for; sets its weight
field_help.tcp_options: canonical option string of the SYN, see src/tcp_opts.py
field_help.tcp_options_ordered: optional; derived from tcp_options when missing
field_help.tcp_data_offset: TCP data offset in 32 bit words (5 = no options)
field_help.ip_total_length: IPv4 total length of the bare SYN (IP + TCP + options)
field_help.ip_ttl_initial: TTL the sender most likely started with (64, 128, 255)
field_help.tcp_window_size: window size announced in the SYN
field_help.tcp_window_scaling: window scale value, null when the option is absent
field_help.tcp_mss: maximum segment size option, null when absent
field_help.ip_id_zero: 1 when the IPv4 identification field is zero, 0 when not, null when unknown
field_help.tcp_timestamp: 1 when the SYN carries a timestamp option, null when unknown
field_help.tcp_timestamp_echo: value the timestamp echo field carries (always 0 in a SYN)
field_help.tcp_flags: TCP flags of the SYN (0x02 = SYN only)
field_help.source: where the profile came from: 'hand written' or the table it was imported from
field_help.note: free text, ignored by the scorer
